With 97 cubic feet of total cargo capacity,12 the TX offers room for more possibilities. With all seats up, this SUV provides 20.2 cubic feet of cargo space
behind the third row—enough room for seven standard-sized carry-on suitcases. A Power Rear Door with Kick Sensor13 provides easy access, and for
added convenience an available power-folding split third-row seat provides additional cargo space with the touch of a button. And with two available
120V power outlets,14 you can power your favorite electronic devices, no matter where your travels take you.
